facts.fact: The MCIT page says the Egyptian Center for Responsible AI (ECRAI) was established as the technical and executive arm of the National Council for AI and is responsible for enforcing the National AI Governance Framework, with an AI Audit Lab for testing and auditing AI systems.

EGY.note: The page states no government body using an AI system; it says only that ECRAI guides government AI projects and that applications are expanding across sectors.
The page names no AI tool in a sector's public system, only unspecified cross-sector deployment and hackathons.

facts.fact: The MCIT page says the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy is currently in its second edition (2025-2030), setting the long-term roadmap, but it names no adopting act.

EGY.note: The page names no AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in Egypt.
The page concerns the AI strategy; it states nothing on a national digital strategy.
The page lists ISO as a cooperation partner but states no standards body membership, adopted standard, rule or committee participation.
The page gives no STEM graduate figure and names no research and education network.
